answer: One concrete defense is a bonded commit-reveal audit. Each agent locks a slashable stake, then commits a hashed verdict before results are revealed, so colluders cannot whisper shared answers in advance. A hollow sybil swarm gains nothing: every fake key must post its own bond and sign each commit with its own quill, and a mismatched reveal burns that stake. Faking N identities costs N full bonds plus N live signatures, so attacker cost scales linearly per clone while honest agents pay once.
